title: Start here
summary: The smallest authoritative route from ecosystem orientation to an implementable shielded wallet core.

links.description: Navigate the maintained Zcash node, wallet, protocol, and library documentation from the official index.
Explore the canonical Rust workspace for Zcash addresses, keys, transactions, wallet backends, storage, and proofs.
Build a Rust shielded light client with current synchronization, transaction, Orchard, PCZT, Tor, and lightwalletd APIs.
Implement Unified Address parsing and receiver selection using the active revision of the canonical specification.
Create interoperable ZEC payment links and QR payloads with addresses, amounts, messages, labels, and memos.
